data.name: Madiar
data.gender_notes: Madiar is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Dar', which means 'light' or 'to light'. The name Madiar signifies 'Light of God'. In Islamic belief, light is often used as a metaphor for knowledge and guidance from Allah. The name Madiar carries the meaning “Light of God” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Madiar usually hope their child will grow to embody light of god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine guidance and enlightenment.
data.etymology: Madiar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Light of God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Madiar total 1, giving a life-path number of 1. Number 1 is linked with Sun and with the qualities of leadership, independence and initiative.

in_arabic.name: ماديار
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من مادة، يعني المكان الذي يمد فيه الناس
in_arabic.long_meaning: ماديار هو اسم مشتق من المادة، و يعني المكان الذي يمد فيه الناس بالماء أو الطعام. ويرتبط هذا الاسم بالعطاء والكرم، كما ورد في القرآن الكريم في سياق الحديث عن الرزق وال provision.

in_urdu.name: ماديار
in_urdu.meaning: ایک ایسا مقام جہاں لوگوں کو مدد ملتی ہے
in_urdu.long_meaning: ماديار ایک ایسا نام ہے جو مادہ سے ماخوذ ہے، یعنی وہ مقام جہاں لوگوں کو مدد ملتی ہے، خاص طور پر پانی یا خوراک کی فراہمی کے حوالے سے. یہ نام عطاء اور کرم کے ساتھ منسلک ہے، جیسا کہ قرآن کریم میں رزق اور فراہمی کے حوالے سے ذکر کیا گیا ہے.

in_hindi.name: मादियार
in_hindi.meaning: एक ऐसा स्थान जहां लोगों को सहायता मिलती है
in_hindi.long_meaning: मादियार एक ऐसा नाम है जो मादा से व्युत्पन्न है, यानी वह स्थान जहां लोगों को सहायता मिलती है, विशेष रूप से पानी या भोजन की आपूर्ति के संबंध में. यह नाम दान और उदारता के साथ जुड़ा हुआ है, जैसा कि कुरआन में रज़क और प्रोविजन के संबंध में उल्लेख किया गया है.

in_pashto.name: مادیار
in_pashto.meaning: هغه ځای چې خلکو ته پکې مرسته کیږي
in_pashto.long_meaning: مادیار داسې نوم دی چې د مادې څخه اخیستل شوی دی، يعنی هغه ځای چې خلکو ته پکې مرسته کیږي، خاصه توګه د اوبو یا خوراک د رسولو په اړه. دا نوم د عطا او کرم سره تړلی دی، لکه څنګه چې په قرآن کریم کې د رزق او فراہمی په اړه ذکر شوی دی.

in_english.meaning: A place where people are helped or assisted

It reflects the importance of aiding others and the spiritual significance of being a source of comfort and relief in times of need.

Therefore, the name Madiar represents the belief that girls are carriers of knowledge, wisdom, and enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's Muqaddimah. The Historian discusses the Maghreb and the city of Madinat al-Fath (present-day Fez) in Morocco. The city was founded by Idris I in 789 AD and named Madinat al-Fath (City of Victory). Over time, the name Madinat al-Fath evolved into Madar or Madiar.
historical_references.context: Founding and Evolution of City Names

historical_references.reference: Al-Qadiri, Abu Abd Al-Rahman Al. The famous Sufi scholar, Al-Qadiri, was born in the city of Madar, in present-day Algeria, in 1038 AD. The city was a significant center for Sufi practices and learning during his time.
historical_references.context: Sufi Scholars and Centers of Learning
